resources.string: Counts Instagram reels you scroll past and how many screens (pages) you scroll in the Facebook app and on facebook.com in your browser. It can show a small floating counter on top of those apps. It notes which app is open so it can hide the counter elsewhere, and only reads scroll events and the browser address bar. Nothing leaves your phone.
Counter is OFF — enable it in Accessibility settings
Android 13+: if the switch is greyed out, open App info → ⋮ → \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Show counter on top of Instagram & Facebook
Drag the badge to move it. It turns red when you reach a daily limit.
No events yet. Scroll in Instagram or Facebook, then tap Refresh.
